title: Yanis — Le livreur qui voulait sa flotte
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Yanis
character.description: Yanis, a 35-year-old North African man, short dark hair with a fade cut, stubble beard, athletic build, wearing a black delivery jacket with a hi-vis vest, determined brown eyes

scenes.vo: Ça fait six ans que Yanis livre. Six ans qu'il connaît chaque rue, chaque raccourci, chaque client.
scenes.image_prompt: Yanis on a delivery scooter riding through a Parisian street at dawn, delivery box on the back, city waking up, warm morning light
scenes.motion_prompt: He rides steadily through the street, buildings gliding past, morning light flares softly

scenes.vo: Et depuis six ans, il a la même idée en tête : sa propre société de livraison. Sa flotte. Ses couleurs.
scenes.image_prompt: Yanis pausing at a red light, gazing at a fleet of branded delivery vans passing by, his eyes following them with longing and determination
scenes.motion_prompt: The vans pass one by one, his head follows them, slow push-in on his determined gaze

scenes.vo: Mais monter une boîte tout seul ? Sans comptable. Sans partenaire. Sans personne pour lui ouvrir une porte.
scenes.image_prompt: Yanis at night at a small desk in his apartment, surrounded by printed paperwork and administrative forms, head in his hands, dim lamp light
scenes.motion_prompt: He rubs his face wearily over the paperwork, the lamp flickers, papers stir slightly

scenes.vo: Alors chaque année, il repousse. « L'année prochaine, incha'Allah. »
scenes.image_prompt: Calendar pages on a wall showing years passing, Yanis in delivery gear walking past the same wall each time, slightly more tired, muted colors
scenes.motion_prompt: Calendar pages flip, he walks past in a loop, colors slowly desaturate

scenes.vo: Jusqu'au soir où il découvre Nour Meet. Des soirées networking. Des entrepreneurs. Des gens qui sont passés exactement par là.
scenes.image_prompt: Yanis's face lit warmly by his phone showing a networking dinner event card in a clean app interface, his eyes widening with hope, dark kitchen background turning warm
scenes.motion_prompt: The warm glow of the screen grows, he leans in, his expression shifts from tired to hopeful

scenes.vo: À une table, il rencontre Karim. Gérant d'une société de transport. Qui cherchait un homme de terrain. Exactement lui.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm restaurant networking dinner, Yanis in a clean shirt talking passionately with an older confident businessman, both leaning in, exchanging phones, engaged conversation
scenes.motion_prompt: They talk with animated gestures, the businessman nods approvingly, they exchange contacts on their phones

scenes.vo: Trois mois plus tard, Yanis ne livre plus pour les autres.
scenes.image_prompt: Yanis proudly standing in front of his first delivery van with a fresh company logo, keys in hand, huge smile, bright daylight, small depot in the background
scenes.motion_prompt: He tosses the keys and catches them, the camera slowly rises revealing the branded van, he beams with pride

scenes.vo: Les bonnes portes existent. Il faut juste rencontrer ceux qui les ouvrent. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
